entitlement: A faculty member who determines that certain personal circumstances may impede his or her progress toward achieving demonstration of eligibility for recommendation of award of tenure may make a written request for extension specifying the reason(s) for the requested extension.

The decision regarding the request shall be made by the Executive Vice President and Provost (Provost), upon recommendation of the Department Head and the Dean, within 30 working days from the date the request is received in the Office of the Provost.
It is the responsibility of the faculty member to provide appropriate documentation to adequately demonstrate why the request should be granted.
duration: The request for extension shall be limited to one academic year.

A request for an additional academic year's extension will follow the established request process, with the maximum duration of extension, whether consecutive or nonconsecutive, to be two academic years.
time_window: Normally, requests for extension must be made in advance of the academic year or semester for which the extension is desired and may be made no later than three months prior to the deadline for initiation of the mandatory review process

notes: Sources: 2018_00_link.txt (HR leave page, undated, capture 2018-03-11); 2018_01_utdbp3054_leaves_of_absence_policy.txt (UTDBP3054 v4, revised 2013-10-14); 2018_03_utdpp1051_faculty_leave_without_pay.txt (UTDPP1051); 2018_04_utdpp1077_promotion_tenure_standards.txt (UTDPP1077).
Reference date 2018-02-26. Lead version notes say UTDBP3054 v4, UTDPP1051 and UTDPP1077 were in force on that date.

the no-policy coding (`missing`) not applied: governing documents for faculty leave covering tenure-stream faculty are saved: UTDPP1051 (faculty leave without pay), UTDBP3054 (its FMLA section covers 'All University employees'; its sick, emergency and annual-leave sections state their faculty scope), and UTDPP1077 (tenure-clock extension). missing = false.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave and no modified duties appear in the usable sources: the HR page states 'Maternity Leave falls under FMLA', with sick leave (during certified incapacity) and vacation used inside the 12 weeks, then leave without pay. Annual leave is not available to faculty appointed for less than 12 months.

UTDBP3054's general-policy line says its leave policies 'should be followed by all non-teaching personnel'; each section's own scope was applied: FMLA 'All University employees'; sick leave and emergency leave name faculty at 50% time; annual leave excludes faculty appointed under 12 months; the general leave of absence without pay is for non-teaching personnel (UTDPP1051 governs faculty).

U8: the HR page describes a University Parental Leave Policy / State of Texas Parental Leave Act for employees not eligible for FMLA (12 weeks, continuous, from the birth or placement; child under three; no premium sharing). Recorded in c1's duration_note, not as a component. The HR page also says (line 184) 'University of Texas at Dallas employees, including employees who are not eligible for FMLA leave, are entitled to a parental leave of absence', while lines 177 and 179 limit it to employees not eligible for FMLA; the more specific statements were followed. The Parental Leave Policy is cited (also in UTDBP3054's annual-leave section) but not saved.
During unpaid FMLA leave the University continues its share of health-insurance premiums (premium sharing); this is not pay and is noted in c1's description.

UTDPP1077 also states that a probationary year is accrued by at least nine months of full-time academic service in an academic year; it names no leave and is not coded as a tenure-clock component (an implicit exclusion only).

UTDBP3054 mentions 'extended disability leave, when available' as counting toward the 12 FMLA weeks; no such plan is described or saved. The HR page mentions disability retirement; not a parental provision.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth): paid military leave, National Guard emergency leave, jury duty, death-in-family and coworker-funeral leave, voting absence, 8 hours of sick leave for parent-teacher conferences (part of c2's balance).

Cited but not saved: UT Dallas Parental Leave Policy; Administrative Policies and Procedures D6-155.0 and Section D6; D6-130.0 Extended Unpaid Military Leave; Regents' Rules and Regulations Rule 30201 Sec. 3, Rule 31007 Sec. 5.1, Rule 31002 Sec. 1, Rule 31008 Sec. 6.1; Policy Memorandum 75-III.22-3; HRS Manual (Personnel Events Section); Outside Employment, Compensatory Time and Emergency Leave policies; State Auditor leave interpretation letters 98-06, 98-03, 79-01 and Technical Update Letter 01-01; FMLA request and certification forms; Sick Leave Pool application forms; the State of Texas Parental Leave Act text.

Calendar: semesters are named ('the beginning of the next semester', UTDPP1051; 'regular, long semesters', UTDPP1077) without a length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1), with own sick leave within it during certified incapacity (c2, own balance; vacation c3 not available to academic-year faculty) -> sick leave pool after sick leave only for life-threatening complications (c4, discretionary, donated) -> faculty leave without pay beyond the 12 weeks (c5, discretionary, general purpose).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (c1), with own sick leave within it while caring for the spouse's certified recovery (c2) -> faculty leave without pay beyond the 12 weeks (c5, discretionary, general purpose).
